name: Monk/Rogue Class Tweaks
notes: Posted to #proposal-discussions on 2026-10-26 as 'Monk/Rogue Tweaks' (document title: 'Monk/Rogue Class Tweaks'). The document bundles several changes (Monk Slow Fall, Chi Block with an open hand, Freedom of Movement replacing Evasion for Monks, Evasion's 60-second rest cooldown, fortification falling damage, and the Earthquake relic) but does not designate any of them as line-item votes, so per Zachary's 2026-10-30 rule it is tracked as a single all-or-nothing poll. Wording flag from the doc read: the Intent summary describes the Chi Block change as a foot option, but the operative proposed wording says an open hand. In the discussion thread cairo said he is open to sections being voted as line items, but the document itself does not call any out. Rationale in the doc: give Monks different flavor and class utility; the fortification rule codifies a long-played practice; no substantive rationale is stated for the Evasion change.
summary: Monks gain Slow Fall at Rank 10: no damage from jumping or falling off fortification walls.
Chi Block at Rank 20 can be performed with an open hand as well as with Monk Hands.
At Rank 20, Monks learn Freedom of Movement instead of Evasion — Big Game Hunter effects plus immunity to Hold spells and effects.
Evasion becomes Rogue-only: duration changes from Permanent to Instant, and resting for 60 seconds regains it.

New fortification rule — jumping or falling from a fortification wall causes a light wound to each leg (the damage Slow Fall negates) — and a new Monk relic, Earthquake: a quarterstaff that strikes per Shield Break and deals magical damage (magical yellow only when wielded one-handed).
